subject: application_plan
summary: W2 ApplicationPlan applies standard OpenAPI + OCL to elevate W1 named missing/not-visible and unauthorized lookup failure stubs (no mutation), defers formal with Brief X8 / no concurrency_safety rationale, and correctly leaves human_gate false for additive authz work. solidsdd-lint pass with zero findings. Schema target.covers is WorkPlan item ids only—plan correctly uses ["W2"]; Brief R2/R3/SC2/SC3 and the failure half of R5/SC4 are cited in rationales and match WorkPlan W2.covers. Density meets authz_boundary floor (standard) with http_boundary/domain_contract apply; not plan thinning.

findings.detail: API apply targets openapi/openapi.yaml#/paths/~1reservations~1{holdId}/get, but WorkPlan W2.touches lists only contracts/Reservation.ocl and src/reservation.ts. Elevation is still required for R2/R3/SC2/SC3/SC4 HTTP checkability and matches W1’s deferral of named error channels to W2—not a density or checkability hole; apply (or a WorkPlan touch update) should treat OpenAPI as in-slice.

DbC rationale correctly requires unchanged stock and holds on HoldExists/not-visible failure, but the named posts it lists for missing/not-visible are only HoldMissingOrNotVisibleErrorOnLookup and HoldsUnchangedOnHoldMissingLookup (matching current commented stubs). On apply, also elevate or add an AvailableStockUnchanged-on-missing post (or equivalent derived-test oracle) so R2/SC2 stock-unchanged is as explicit as the unauthorized AvailableStockUnchangedOnUnauthorizedLookup path—polish, not a missing-pre / no-error-channel hole.
